component.name: gfxtune
component.summary: Graphics and game tuning for Steam games

description.p: gfxtune puts the graphics options of Mesa, DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Proton and gamescope in one window, for all your Steam games at once and for each game on its own. Settings apply the next time a game starts, and the in-game filters change while it runs. Made for CachyOS and AMD Radeon cards.

ul.li: Anisotropic filtering, texture detail, vertical sync, an exact frame rate cap and FSR 4, for all games or per game
gamescope with upscaling, or drawing the game larger than the screen and scaling it down
In-game filters drawn by gfxtune's own Vulkan layer: SMAA anti-aliasing, sharpening and colour
Performance measuring for every play session: average frame rate and 1% and 0.1% lows
The graphics card's temperatures, power, clocks and load, live
GameMode and MangoHud, switched on for all games or per game
Frame generation through lsfg-vk, which is installed separately with Lossless Scaling

description.p: gfxtune changes only the launch options of the games it has something to do in, and only while Steam is closed. In games with anti-cheat, the in-game filters and measuring stay off until you accept the risk on the game's page.
